page.title: Gmail
page.organizerDescription: Create rules to organise your inbox automatically

account.autoImplementHint: A proposal you leave untouched for those days becomes a rule. Empty = only by hand.
account.notFound: This Google account is no longer connected.

rules.title: Email rules
rules.empty: You don't have any rules for this account yet.
rules.pickAccount: Pick an account to create the rule

form.name: Rule name (optional)
form.namePlaceholder: If empty, the path or condition is used

sections.immediateActions: Immediate actions (when the email is found)

form.from: Sender (From) contains — who sent the email
form.subject: Subject contains (comma-separated)
form.keywordsHint: Several words must all appear, in any order. For an exact phrase, use quotes: "Google Account".
form.mailKindHint: Ads = emails with a "mailing list" or an "unsubscribe" link. Use it to split a company's marketing from its account emails when both come from the same sender.

inboxTimingOptions.after_days: X days after it was received

form.importantExpiresOnStar: Important expires as soon as it is starred
form.pathsHint: Each path is a complete, independent route, separated by "/" (e.g. Banks/Revolut/Money out). For each path, choose whether the email gets every label along the route or only the last one.

labelModeOptions.ALL_LEVELS: Keep every label in the path
labelModeOptions.LEAF_ONLY: Keep only the final label of the path

search.placeholder: Search rules — name, label, sender, subject…  ( / )
search.label: Search rules

proposals.title: Proposed rules
proposals.intro: Jarvis analyses the emails without labels and proposes rules. Each analysis revisits the proposals you haven't touched — changes them, deletes them or adds new ones. The ones you edit stay as you left them.
proposals.empty: No proposals. Click Analyse now, or pick a frequency on the Email page.
proposals.autoAt: Implements itself on {{date}} unless you touch it.

alerts.analyzed: Analysis done: {{created}} new, {{updated}} revised, {{deleted}} deleted, {{rejected}} rejected ({{unlabeled}} emails without a label).
alerts.dismissed: Proposal dismissed — it won't come back.
alerts.restored: The proposal is back among the pending ones.

connections.permissionsSummary: What Google allowed MyHomeLab to do when you connected the account.
connections.callsSummary: What can be requested from the Gmail API ({{base}}): the calls MyHomeLab already uses and the ones it does not use yet.

scopes.readonly: Read emails, labels and the profile
scopes.modify: Read, change labels, archive, trash, drafts and send
scopes.labels: View, create, change and delete labels
scopes.fullAccess: Everything, including deleting emails for good

calls.messagesList: Search emails with a Gmail query
calls.messageGet: Read an email: headers, snippet or full content
calls.messageModify: Add or remove labels, archive and mark as read
calls.messageTrash: Move an email to the trash
calls.messageUntrash: Take an email out of the trash
calls.labelGet: See a label's counts (total and unread)
calls.draftCreate: Create a reply or forward draft
calls.profileGet: See the profile and total emails of the account
calls.threadModify: Change the labels of a whole conversation
calls.threadTrash: Move a whole conversation to the trash
calls.historyList: See what changed in the mailbox since last time
calls.messagesBatchModify: Change the labels of many emails at once
calls.messageSend: Send an email without a draft
calls.watch: Get notified when an email arrives (needs Google Pub/Sub)
calls.vacationUpdate: Turn on or change the vacation auto-reply
calls.messageDelete: Delete an email for good, skipping the trash
